entries.reason: Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.e2e.spec.ts:1-12: The file documents a real-CCXT keyless e2e suite, gated by `describe.skipIf(!process.env.CCXT_E2E)`, whose stated path is construct -> init -> public history; the range contains no private mutation or journal assertion. Counterexample preserved: A skipped suite contributes no execution evidence, and the enabled path exercises only public keyless reads. Treating it as proof of funded authority, endpoint safety under mutation, or committed outcomes would hide precisely the private and recovery boundaries the new runtime must model. Correction applied: Model the harness as `E2ESelection = DisabledByGate | Enabled(CcxtPublicReadCase)` and the broker authority as `PublicReadOnly` for keyless construction, separate from `Private(CredentialRef, AccountScope)`. Public history may produce a `BarObservation`; it must not create a `PreparedPlanRecord`, lock, job, or dispatch receipt.

Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.e2e.spec.ts:13-51 runs only when CCXT_E2E is enabled; its keyless path loops binance, okx and bybit over 1m/15m/1h/4h/1d, requests 50 rows and checks response shape, ordering and a freshness bound. The repaired target treats those intervals as exercised inputs only, requires a separate venue/environment declaration for interval support, and keeps HistoricalQuality.Unknown until independently bound runtime evidence exists. This remains a finite public pull with no private authority or order transaction; the empirical quality question is retained.

Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Treating constructor success as a ready account is an illegal readiness shortcut. Correction applied: Use a pure `ConnectionGuard = ValidForInit | PublicOnly | InvalidConfiguration` over decoded venue/mode metadata, followed by an Effect-scoped acquisition state. Constructor validation must not be the `Ready` RuntimeHealth variant and must not grant write capability.

Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.spec.ts:339-470 and exchanges/bybit.ts:13-29: Bybit lookup tries open regular, open conditional (`stop:true`), closed regular, then closed conditional; tests cover each path, cache miss/not-found nulls, and full/partial/absent TP/SL price extraction. Counterexample preserved: The ordered endpoint sequence and endpoint-specific failure evidence are hidden behind a nullable legacy method. Transport errors, malformed replies, and complete NotFound are indistinguishable, and TP/SL prices do not prove a native child/attachment identity or atomic protection. Correction applied: Define `BybitLookupPlan = [OpenRegular, OpenConditional, ClosedRegular, ClosedConditional]` and `OrderObservation = Found|NotFound|Unknown|Malformed` with endpoint evidence. Model `ProtectionState = None|Partial|Complete` carrying native attachment/child identities where actually observed. Closure treatment: client-order identity remains namespace-scoped `Unavailable` without per-conditional-path evidence; recovery uses the durable broker id plus endpoint/symbol descriptor and cannot authorize blind idempotent redispatch.

Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.spec.ts:684-762 and CcxtBroker.ts:647-679: tests use Partial<Order> to inherit original price, forward auxPrice->stopPrice, trailStopPrice, trailingPercent, and lower-case tif, and expect `{}` when omitted; source performs no capability check for those extra fields. Counterexample preserved: An untyped Partial<Order> cannot express Keep versus Clear and can send a trailing field whose CCXT/venue meaning is unverified. Lowercasing `tif` does not validate its allowed duration or bind expiry, and silently dropping fields risks changing approved semantics. Correction applied: Define `OrderPatch` with explicit `Keep|Set(value)|Clear` per mutable field, `TimeInForce = Day|Gtc|Ioc|Fok|GoodTill(Instant)`, and `TrailingSpec = Market|Limit` with capability evidence. A stop/trailing/TIF field is either compiled by a verified venue codec or rejected; no entry-only downgrade.

Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.spec.ts:764-813 and CcxtBroker.ts:691-725: closePosition reads getPositions, matches by resolved CCXT symbol or symbol/secType fallback, reverses long/short side, uses `quantity ?? pos.quantity` without an upper-bound check, and delegates to placeOrder. Correction applied: Use first-class `CloseAction { scope, InstrumentId, expectedExposureVersion, requestedQuantity? }` and `ExposureSnapshot`. Compile `SpotClose` or `DerivativeClose { reduceOnly: NativeReduceOnlyCapability }`; enforce `0 < quantity <= absolute exposure` and retain residual exposure semantics.

Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.spec.ts:815-889: tests use Decimal strings for contracts/contractSize, assert exact quantity strings, and assert derivative close sends `reduceOnly:true`; source comments/tests omit reduceOnly for spot because a venue rejects it. A boolean flag hides whether the venue supports native reduce-only; using it on spot is a known rejection, while omitting it on an unsupported derivative could open the opposite side. Correction applied: Use unit-qualified `Contracts`, `ContractSize`, and `BaseQuantity` Decimal values; `CloseEncoding = SpotMarket | DerivativeMarket(reduceOnly: VerifiedNativeCapability)`. The native codec records parameter schema and converts only after precision/lot validation.

Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.spec.ts:891-983: tests assert wallet totals form netLiquidation, stablecoin totals aggregate, spot assets use ticker value, missing credentials fail init, Binance invokes spot/future/delivery balance reads with tolerated delivery failure, and `info.totalInitialMargin`/position PnL roll up. Wallet completeness and source timestamps are absent, so a partial read can look like complete equity. Correction applied: Use `AccountSnapshot = PublicReadOnlyNoAccount | Funded(CompleteAccount) | Funded(IncompleteAccount)` with scoped signed `BalanceObservation`, explicit cash/asset/liability valuations, `FxObservation`/parity evidence, PnL and margin source namespaces. Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. Source evidence: services/uta/src/domain/trading/brokers/ccxt/CcxtBroker.spec.ts:1247-1292 and CcxtBroker.ts:1054-1065: source computes `abs(contracts) * contractSize`, skips the row when quantity is zero, and skips any nonzero row when `this.markets[p.symbol]` is absent; tests assert both results are omitted. Counterexample preserved: Silence makes a complete flat account indistinguishable from an unreadable catalog or malformed position. Dropping a nonzero unknown-market row can falsely clear exposure, while abs/unknown-side behavior can hide native data defects. Correction applied: Return `PositionObservationBatch { rows, completeness, suppressions }`, where `ZeroExposure` is an explicit benign suppression, while `UnknownInstrument`, `CatalogStale`, and `MalformedPosition` remain visible incomplete evidence. Never create a skeletal Contract for unknown identity.

Accepted after source re-check and local semantic repair. It does not prove `.total == free + used` or preserve negative liabilities/incomplete holdings. Correction applied: Use `SpotBalanceObservation { free?, used?, reportedTotal?, scope, walletNamespace, observedAt }`, `SpotHolding = KnownValued|KnownUnvalued|Liability`, and canonical spot `InstrumentId` distinct from derivative. Preserve reported total with consistency evidence; accounting decides cash/FX and cost basis.
